ينتقدوا (form VIII)
# يَنْتَقِدُوا (yantaqidū) /jan.ta.qi.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# يُنْتَقَدُوا (yuntaqadū) /jun.ta.qa.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
